label: Room shell
mass_provenance: Estimated from construction volumes and stated density priors; no measured product weight
test_scope: Offline synthetic tests. Forces and mass are engineering assumptions, not hardware measurements.

physics_properties.mass_status: Estimated from construction volumes and stated density priors; no measured product weight
physics_properties.material: painted plaster, ceramic/glazed tile and floor substrate
physics_properties.density_note: Heterogeneous hollow assembly; use individual bodies, never outer bounding-box volume.
physics_properties.parameter_status: Friction/damping from existing mechanism priors; uncalibrated against real forces. Geometry and inertias are rebuilt from these current assets.

limitations: Hidden construction and material parameters remain estimates.
Metric depth/camera reconstruction has approximately 4% uncertainty; one-centimetre absolute alignment is not certified.
Other asset sets are excluded from these run meshes.

provenance.geometry: Reconstructed from kitchen video; hidden surfaces are completed. Scale and material appearance remain approximate.
provenance.motion: Observed trajectories where documented; unobserved axes and endpoints are assumptions.
provenance.forces: Simulation measurements of assumed parameters; not force measurements from video.

visual_bindings_note: Visuals use the latest asset revision; mechanism geometry may predate it. Body rest offsets preserve the visual placement.
